5348.name: Mercedes-Benz Stadium

parking.name: Official lots and decks
parking.detail: Buy ahead at parking.mercedesbenzstadium.com; lots often sell out. Prices vary by event; each lot's hours come with the booking.

parking.name: The Home Depot Backyard (1 Backyard Way)
parking.detail: Tailgate lot beside the stadium; opens 4.5 hours before the event. No RVs, buses or trailers.

parking.name: Lot 17, Blue Lot, North Gate 1
parking.detail: Official lots on Mangum St SW and Northside Dr NW that allow tailgating; no oversized vehicles.

parking.name: Silver, Red and Orange Decks
parking.detail: Official garages next to the stadium; no tailgating. Height limit 6'8" (Orange Deck 8'2").

parking.name: Marshalling Yard RV/Bus lot
parking.detail: The official RV and bus lot, about 0.7 mi from the stadium; tailgating allowed.

parking.name: Yellow Lot (465 Ivan Allen Jr Blvd NW)
parking.detail: Official tailgate lot about 0.8 mi away; free ADA shuttle to Vine City station by Gate 1.

parking.name: Centennial Yards Tailgating Lot (175 Ted Turner Dr SW)
parking.detail: Not run by the stadium; tailgating allowed, RVs and buses when space allows.

tailgating: Only in The Home Depot Backyard and lots that allow it, for event ticket holders; stay in front of or behind your space.
Tailgating ends 30 minutes after the event start; up to 4 people may then stay at the spot. No overnight parking.
One 10' x 10' tent per space, weighted down, no stakes; take it down before going in.
Propane or natural gas grills only: no charcoal, fryers, wood stoves or open fires.
No single-serve glass, drinking games, or underage or excessive drinking. Generators 6500 W or less on a plywood base.
One space per hangtag, no saving spaces; lots close 2 hours after the event.
5348.gates: Most fans can use any gate. Floor-seat holders use the floor line near Gate 1; suite and club guests use the North Club Entrance or any gate.
5348.bagPolicy: One clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" or a one-gallon clear freezer bag; a small bag up to 4.5" x 6.5" only alongside a clear bag. All other bags are prohibited.
entry: Florida-Georgia tickets are digital, in the Mercedes-Benz Stadium app.
Delta Fly-Through lanes let enrolled fans enter by facial recognition instead of a ticket.
Not allowed: outside food and drink, umbrellas 33 in. or longer, signs or flags over 3' x 5', poles, selfie sticks, drones, noisemakers, weapons.
Smoke-, vape- and tobacco-free, including the gate plazas.
Bag storage (Mobile Locker Co.) at Gate 1 on Northside Dr and Gate 2 on Andrew Young Intl Blvd, 2 hours before to 1.5 hours after.
transit: MARTA to SEC District station (formerly GWCC/CNN Center), next to the stadium; Vine City is the other close stop. $2.50 each way.
Tap a bank card or phone wallet at MARTA faregates (old Breeze cards no longer work). No drinking alcohol on trains.
Rideshare Zone 1: GWCC Bus Lane C on Northside Dr, for Gate 1 and heading north; about a 10-minute walk.
Rideshare Zone 2: Broad St between Trinity Ave and Mitchell St, for Gates 2 to 4; about a 10-minute walk.
Expect heavy traffic on I-75, I-85 and I-20 into downtown.
accessibility: ADA parking in most official lots and decks, booked at parking.mercedesbenzstadium.com, first come, first served.
Free ADA shuttle from the Blue and Yellow Lots to Vine City MARTA station, closest to Gate 1.
Accessible drop-off: Northside Dr in front of The Home Depot Backyard, or Andrew Young Intl Blvd at the Georgia International Plaza or Red Deck.
Mobility Ambassadors arrange wheelchair escorts from the entries to seats and back; no wheelchairs out to the lots.
Assistive listening devices and sensory kits at Guest Services (near Sections 116 and 244) with a government ID; sensory room too.
gameDay: Florida vs Georgia, Sat Oct 31, 2026: kickoff 3:30 p.m. ET on ABC; Georgia is the designated home team.
Gates open at 2 p.m. By the stadium's rules the Backyard opens 4.5 hours before the start and tailgating ends 30 minutes after it (about 11 a.m. and 4 p.m.).
Buy parking ahead at parking.mercedesbenzstadium.com; the stadium says lots often sell out before the event.
First Florida-Georgia game in Atlanta while EverBank Stadium is renovated; Tampa hosts in 2027.
Florida Alumni Association's Gator Nation headquarters: Wild Leap, 125 Ted Turner Dr SW, a few blocks from the stadium.

3634.name: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium

parking.name: Reserved lots (Gator Boosters)
parking.detail: Reserved campus lots and UAA RV lots are for Gator Boosters at set levels; digital passes. Boosters office (800) 344-2867 option 3.

parking.name: Public general lots
parking.detail: A limited number of non-reserved lots, first come, first served; they fill fast. Cars on sidewalks are towed.

parking.name: Lot 113 (visiting team fans)
parking.detail: $30, paid in the Passport app. Questions: UF TAPS 352-392-7275.

parking.name: Lot 109 (public disabled parking)
parking.detail: South of Archer Rd on Gale Lemerand Dr; non-reserved disabled parking with a free lift-equipped shuttle to the stadium.

parking.name: Game Day Shuttle lots
parking.detail: Celebration Pointe (behind Regal Cinemas), UF Park and Ride #2 (3497 Hull Rd), Garage 109; $20 adult, $10 under 12 on game day.

parking.name: Gators RV City (Lot 78, Florida Park)
parking.detail: Opens 4 p.m. Friday, RVs out by noon Sunday; the only UAA RV lot allowing overnight stays. Other UAA RV lots empty after the game.

parking.name: Public RV parking
parking.detail: For RVs without a Boosters pass, call UF Transportation and Parking Services, 352-392-8048.

parking.name: Charter buses
parking.detail: Park on Village Drive, north of Museum Road.

tailgating: Set up from 6 a.m. on game day (8 a.m. in UAA lots); everything cleared by 3 a.m. after the game.
Open outdoor campus areas, first come, first served; none in garages, on rooftops or non-designated spaces; no saving spots.
Tents up to 12' x 10', no ground stakes, not inside a parking space; keep walkways, ramps, fire lanes and roads clear.
Grills attended, on level ground, 25 ft from buildings, vehicles and structures; no open fires, fire pits or ground fires.
Alcohol 21+ only, 6 a.m. game day to 3 a.m.; open containers stay in the tailgate area. Tobacco-free campus.
Bring your own muffled generator (no campus outlets); no portable toilets, no drones; personal golf carts kept out of the secured area.
3634.gates: All gates open 2 hours before kickoff (2026). Enter at the gate on your ticket; free Express Entry by face at Gates 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 and 16 and the Skybox and Champions Club lobbies.
3634.bagPolicy: One clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" (or a one-gallon clear storage bag) plus a clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5". Other bags (purses, fanny packs, camera bags, seatbacks) are refused; no bag check at the gates.
entry: Mobile tickets only, in the Florida Gators app; add them to Apple Wallet or Google Pay. Screenshots are not accepted.
No re-entry once your ticket is scanned (medical pass at the first aid stations; weather delays excepted).
One empty, commercially branded plastic water bottle up to 20 oz; fill it at the stations inside.
Not allowed: outside food or drink, umbrellas, strollers, flags, noisemakers, selfie sticks, video cameras, laser pointers, tobacco and vapes.
Seat cushions up to 16" with no back or pockets are fine. Concessions and Sportshops are cashless.
Bag and no-bag lines at each entry; all bags searched. Ticket help at the O'Connell Center Gate 1 ticket office.
transit: Game Day Shuttle (UAA): park at Celebration Pointe, UF Park and Ride #2 (3497 Hull Rd) or Garage 109; $20 adult, $10 under 12.
Shuttles run from 3 hours before kickoff until kickoff; returns start in the 4th quarter. Drop-off at Van Fleet Hall.
RTS is not running Gator Aider game-day buses in the 2026 season.
Rideshare: dedicated pick-up and drop-off on Woodlawn Drive by Flavet Field (UFPD, Sept 2026).
Closed to cars 3 hours before kickoff to 2 hours after: University Ave (Gale Lemerand to NW 17th St), Gale Lemerand and Stadium Rd.
Gale Lemerand north of Museum Rd needs a parking pass from 5 hours out; Fletcher Dr is one way north. UAA's Waze routes each lot.
accessibility: Public disabled parking: Lot 109, or any open disabled space outside the three reserved areas; reserved disabled lots are full.
Free lift-equipped shuttle from Lot 109: 3 hours before kickoff until kickoff, again from the 4th quarter; drops at Van Fleet Hall.
Golf carts at Gate 18 take guests on to their gate; after the game carts stop at Gates 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 for 30 minutes.
EZ Event Ride: free pick-up and drop-off from non-reserved lots around campus, before and after the game, first come, first served.
Family restrooms on the west side (Gate 2 corridor between sections 6 and 8, behind section 15); nursing suite between Gates 15 and 16.
Only trained service dogs are allowed in the stadium.
